body:
START-ACK 03:41: taking STORY-1419 (rework-ready signal in `aida awaiting`).

WHY THIS ONE of the three: I have the context from tonight's marker audit — the
8-of-24 measurement was exactly `head vs reviewed_sha`, computed by hand, which
is the workaround this spec is written to remove. STORY-1417 and STORY-1418 both
want architecture evidence I do not have.

SCOPE I AM TAKING: the smallest slice the spec names — a row in `aida awaiting`
for a PR carrying a blocking verdict whose current head differs from that
verdict's reviewed_sha, scoped to the seat that recorded it, reporting both shas
and the PR number. NOT classifying rebase-vs-rework, per the spec's own warning.

ON THE DEPENDENCY: the spec says this depends on BUG-1538/BUG-1539 and is worth
building in that order. I am building it anyway, with eyes open, because it
DEGRADES CLEANLY: a verdict with no reviewed_sha simply produces no row, which
is the same silence as today rather than a wrong row. My earlier measurement says
that is 19% of spec-keyed and 24% of PR-keyed open verdicts, so the signal covers
roughly three quarters of live cases immediately. I will state that limit in the
code rather than let it look complete.

Say stop if you would rather it waited for the provenance fixes.
subject: START-ACK: taking STORY-1419 — building before BUG-1538 deliberately, it degrades to silence not to a wrong row
